text:
maya: Quick note  vendor cutover completed and they issued new 401k plan IDs. Payroll, did any 3/31 deferrals land on the old plan?
dan: Can you paste old vs new plan IDs and the payruns? Ill pull the exports.
maya: Old: PLN-RED-12345 New: RWF-2026-401K-01 Payruns: 2026-03-15, 2026-03-31. Migration doc: https://vendor.example.com/migration-guide (internal).
luis: Vendor said ACHs received by 2026-03-30 posted normally; ACHs on 3/31 were flagged and held. They will accept an offcycle remittance CSV to process held amounts and can include match entries if marked as "employer match".
jenna: My 3/31 paystub shows pre-tax withheld but not on vendor portal  is that the hold? :thinking_face: 
dan: payroll-bot: export_ready payroll_run=2026-03-31 export=/exports/payroll_2026-03-31_deductions.csv 
dan: Export shows some entries still pointing at old plan id. We need benefits to provide impacted employee list + amounts so we can remap and send offcycle.
maya: Ill produce CSV with columns: employee_id, full_name, ssn_last4, payrun_id, withheld_amount, withheld_date and upload to /shared/people-ops/401k-recon/2660013456.csv by EOD.
luis: Vendor deposit format: employee_id,ssn_last4,amount_pre_tax,match_amount,plan_id. Example: 10234,6789,250.00,125.00,RWF-2026-401K-01
dan: Need GL mapping for booking match vs deferrals. Propose offcycle date 2026-04-07 after validation.
samir: Finance approves offcycle 2026-04-07. Use GL 6002 (employee deferrals) and GL 6003 (employer match). Memo: "Vendor cutover reconciliation - March 31 withheld amounts."
maya: Tax question  do we need any tax reversals?
luis: No reversal; this is remittance of already-withheld amounts. If we had gross corrections we'd involve tax ops, but not needed here.
jenna: Please include me  my withheld_amount for 3/31 is 250.00.
dan: Action items: maya: impacted CSV by EOD; luis: vendor template & upload steps; dan: remap & schedule offcycle ACH for 2026-04-07; samir: finance memo.
payroll-bot: reminder  vendor offcycle file due 2026-04-05 23:59 PT.
